comment: The dangerous case, recorded. The principal holds Reader on ONE resource group, so it cannot read permissions at the subscription's own scope and ARM answers 403 AuthorizationFailed. scope_verified stays false and the code is SCOPE_UNVERIFIED (Req 12.3, 12.12) — and note that this same principal's inventory query would succeed and return that group's resources, which is exactly why the gate cannot be a coverage check.
